title: AI Packaging & Serialization Inspector
short: Checks every pack for print, label and code errors with computer vision, and reconciles serial numbers before release.
symptom: Packaging errors slip through to the market
ingredient: A vision inspector for packaging lines
directions: Install a camera on the line and connect the serialization system. Defects and code mismatches are flagged in real time for the line supervisor.
problem: Wrong batch or expiry prints, label mix-ups, damaged cartons and unreadable 2D codes cause recalls; serial-number reconciliation across levels is complex.
why: Packaging errors are a frequent cause of recalls and can put the wrong medicine or information in a patient’s hands.
solution: A vision model inspects text (batch, expiry), label identity, carton integrity and code readability on every unit, while rules reconcile serial numbers between unit, case and pallet before upload.
data: Labelled images of good and defective packs
limitations: Vision systems must be validated for each product and line
Lighting and line speed affect accuracy
review: Line supervisors and QA confirm rejects and approve batch release.
